owner: Primary agent; all scientific evaluation and acceptance remain with the primary agent
objective: Quantify continuous shared-calibration error radii and control-parameter neighborhoods for actual encoded-CNOT implementations, without treating numerical roots as exact robust points.

task.inputs: All eight-dimensional states, including entanglement with an arbitrary reference
task.target: The archived phase-specified encoded CNOT on the symmetric spin-3/2 sector, with the declared identity action on both hidden spin-1/2 multiplicity copies; one full-register global phase is immaterial
task.output: Full physical channel; no projection, postselection or renormalization
task.continuations: Any common subsequent quantum channel contracts the stated half-diamond distance; no intermediate reusable-module guarantee is inferred for C
task.errors: Two shared quasistatic fractional calibration offsets x and y, constant across all 90 slots, in the closed square |x|,|y| <= r
task.excluded_errors: Unknown actuator transfer function, intra-slot fluctuations, local gain inhomogeneity, leakage-inducing couplings and module-independent gain offsets
task.metric: sup half diamond distance to the fixed complete target, bounded via operator-norm error of full eight-dimensional unitaries
task.secondary_noise: Optional known local Markov dephasing at gamma*t0=1e-5, charged by a separately derived 3*gamma*T/2 channel-distance bound

controls.selection: Use all five pre-existing complete-target candidates; no selection based on the new radius results
controls.strong_baseline: Archived finite-noise optimized F_C and nominal-duration N; their optimization objectives and budgets remain as originally recorded, so radius differences are library comparisons only
controls.parametrization: 3 blocks of 44 real parameters; 45 rotation areas theta, 42 free axes phi, 45 twisting areas chi; physical schedule is modules 2,1,0, each twisting then rotation
controls.constraints: Signed controls, |theta|,|chi|<=4*pi, |phi|<=8*pi; original known actuator tau_b=0.02*t0, caps 10/t0 and 1/t0, minimum slot 0.04*t0, all 89 switches at 0.001*t0
controls.control_distance: Weighted l1 radius W = 1.5 sum|Delta theta| + 1.5 sum|theta_base| |Delta phi| + 3 sum|Delta chi|. Also report the conservative equal per-area tolerance W/202.5 with axes fixed.
controls.local_family: C only: numerical continuation at s=-0.04,-0.02,0,0.02,0.04 in a seeded area-only null direction of the joint target/response Jacobian; fixed axes; weighted l2 area coordinates (weights 1.5 and 3), plus a fixed gauge v dot (z-z0)=s
controls.family_stopping: At most 15 minimum-norm Newton corrections per point, at most 8 step halvings, target constraint residual <=1e-10; record failures without changing the registered s values
controls.family_budget: All candidates <=120*t0; the local C family and its delivered neighborhoods additionally require <=20*t0

bounds.construction: Bivariate full-unitary Taylor coefficients obtained by ordered product convolution; keep actual nominal and first-order residuals; remainder <= ((S_R+S_T)*r)^(K+1)/(K+1)! with S_R=1.5 sum|theta|, S_T=3 sum|chi|
bounds.coefficient_verification: Outward-rounded real/imaginary interval matrix arithmetic; elementary pulse sin/cos enclosed by directed Decimal Taylor arithmetic; SVD is only a proposed factorization and its norm bound must be verified by interval residuals and Gram bounds
bounds.control_neighborhood: For base bound B(r), the full-control neighborhood satisfies error <= B(r)+(1+r)W. Intersect with admissible controls and account for duration changes.
bounds.noise_radius_search: Monotone bisection of the verified polynomial-plus-remainder upper bound on 0<=r<=0.05, 60 iterations; final returned radius must pass an outward-rounded inequality
bounds.no_exact_root_claim: Residuals are bounded, not replaced by zero. Numerically continued controls are not called interval-certified manifold roots.

registered_evaluation.primary: delta=0.01, r=0.01; test whether C has positive residual control budget W>=0.001
registered_evaluation.secondary: Report all prescribed radii/tolerances and all failures. A smaller radius is not a replacement success criterion.
registered_evaluation.grid: 41x41 error grid at r=0.01 for each candidate; corners and center at other registered radii; finite samples are diagnostics only
registered_evaluation.independent_propagation: Tensor-product single-qubit rotations and diagonal twisting versus direct scipy.linalg.expm on Pauli-tensor Hamiltonians; deterministic points and finite-difference derivative checks
registered_evaluation.geometry: Report ranks and singular values of response-only, target-only and joint Jacobians in fixed coordinates, directional checks, and continuation residuals

acceptance: Full8 physical target and all symmetry-sector actions verified independently
The analytic remainder and Duhamel neighborhood arguments are personally audited
Every delivered continuous-domain number is backed by outward-rounded arithmetic; grids remain labeled diagnostics
The primary result is reported whether positive or negative
Practical usefulness is tied to the declared dimensionless calibration and control tolerances, not an unspecified device or a fault-tolerance threshold
